attachments.avoid: Undirected parameter grids or equating confidence with irreversible action.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Equal marginal evidence with different independent-provenance rank.
attachments.recommended_attack: Derive a finite Markov or quasi-potential model, then run matched upward and downward sweeps with marginal accuracy and common-shock strength fixed.
attachments.reusable_output: Analytic approximation, saved protocol trace, and hysteresis/scaling surface.
attachments.scale_up_when: The frozen small model identifies the signature and its target operating region.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest validator system with two correlated provenance sectors and one incompatible safe action.

attachments.avoid: Assuming sample independence or counting replicas as independent evidence.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: More rounds without new provenance versus one genuinely independent provenance input.
attachments.recommended_attack: Solve the protocol as an indistinguishability game using exact enumeration, coupling, or linear programming and pair the bound with an achiever.
attachments.reusable_output: Scoped risk lower bound, assumptions, matching protocol, and minimal defeating counterexample.
attachments.scale_up_when: The bound is tight on the declared finite class and its assumptions are machine-checkable.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: One latent common shock, repeated subsampling, and one authenticated independent evidence source.

attachments.avoid: Leaking the distinction through hyperedge labels or brute-forcing labeled graphs.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Pairwise equivalence versus one frozen ternary intervention.
attachments.recommended_attack: Canonically enumerate orbit representatives and synthesize two processes identical on every pairwise record and intervention but separated by one hyperedge action.
attachments.reusable_output: Minimal process pair, pairwise-equivalence certificate, and separating intervention.
attachments.scale_up_when: Exhaustion confirms that no smaller typed process supports the distinction.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A genuine three-party typed process with one ternary intervention.

attachments.avoid: Calling every extra quorum, vote, or message a loop-filling operation.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: An additional evidence edge versus a relation that actually fills the loop.
attachments.recommended_attack: Present a finite path category or 2-complex, compute loop generators and the normal closure induced by the higher certificate, and derive the invariant algebra.
attachments.reusable_output: Normal-form theorem, executable reducer, proof certificate, and tight counterexample.
attachments.scale_up_when: The one-loop result is representation-stable and independently verified.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: One unresolved reconciliation loop and one candidate 2-cell relation.

attachments.avoid: Sweeping rule tables before quotienting symmetries or hiding the selector in readout.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: A symmetry-preserving selector versus one explicitly declared asymmetric resource.
attachments.recommended_attack: Prove the equivariance obstruction first and use symmetry-reduced CA or QCA search only to locate the smallest tight specimen.
attachments.reusable_output: Scoped no-go, exact automorphism assumptions, saturating model, and minimal escape resource.
attachments.scale_up_when: The symmetry theorem and the smallest construction meet at the same boundary.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A homogeneous reversible orbit with symmetric candidate record sites.

attachments.avoid: Enumerating the global state space when locality already bounds the witness.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Identical radius-r cones with adversarially varied exterior states.
attachments.recommended_attack: Propagate the behavioral partition symbolically through causal cones using local rule composition, transfer matrices, or tensor-network light cones.
attachments.reusable_output: Local witness radius, complexity bound, and tight example.
attachments.scale_up_when: The local bound is verified against exhaustive global behavior on small systems.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest local CA or QCA depth at which one admitted intervention separates two histories.

attachments.avoid: Defining finality as a threshold and thereby making the theorem tautological.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Equal raw evidence and provenance with versus without loop resolution.
attachments.recommended_attack: Define actions before certificates, compute the lower-layer loop syndrome, and compare an evidence-only layer with one imposing the exact missing relation.
attachments.reusable_output: Necessary/sufficient conditions, paired protocol traces, and a model-checking certificate.
attachments.scale_up_when: The result survives a frozen nontrivial adversary and a second representation.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest split-view loop supporting one pair of incompatible safe actions.

attachments.avoid: Assuming reversible views, global state, or common knowledge.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Predicted invariant facts versus actually safe actions under every frozen view map.
attachments.recommended_attack: Compute the equalizer or invariant action algebra directly and model-check whether exactly those facts remain safe across admissible view changes.
attachments.reusable_output: Equalizer algorithm, proof conditions, and the smallest boundary counterexample.
attachments.scale_up_when: The correspondence is exact on a declared protocol class and fails legibly outside it.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: Two noninvertible certified-view maps with a nontrivial common safe subobject.

attachments.avoid: Counting signature bytes while ignoring key setup, trust roots, and verification work.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: One fewer provenance distinction versus the first sufficient authenticated distinction.
attachments.recommended_attack: Use an indistinguishability or communication-complexity game, synthesize the shortest attack schedule, and minimize authenticated provenance needed to prevent it.
attachments.reusable_output: Lower bound, minimal attack trace, and matching protocol when available.
attachments.scale_up_when: The attack and achiever share the same frozen trust and resource contract.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: One equivocator and the fewest honest recipients able to acquire incompatible certified views.

attachments.avoid: Monte Carlo adversary search that can miss the decisive rare schedule.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: A sufficient frozen refinement versus the shortest adaptive split-view strategy.
attachments.recommended_attack: Encode the problem as a two-player game and compute the symbolic fixpoint with antichains or abstract interpretation.
attachments.reusable_output: Independently replayable refinement certificate or adversarial trace.
attachments.scale_up_when: Both return branches are complete on the tiny class and scale compositionally.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest finite state space with an adaptive scheduler and one possible refinement.

attachments.avoid: Re-proving zero knowledge or inferring that an undisclosed witness was never instantiated.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: A verified action with versus without disclosure of the witness biography.
attachments.recommended_attack: Instantiate the known construction as an executable positive control and map witness, verification, disclosure, reconstruction, and action to separate fields.
attachments.reusable_output: Reusable control fixture and exact DU implication crosswalk.
attachments.scale_up_when: The mapping preserves the cryptographic assumptions and the DU action semantics.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A minimal standard commitment and zero-knowledge relation enabling one certified action.

attachments.avoid: Equating proof size with total certification or provenance cost.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Shrinking proof bytes while holding total certification task and security fixed.
attachments.recommended_attack: Track proof, reference string, verifier state, trusted parties, assumptions, and provenance through a resource-preserving reduction.
attachments.reusable_output: Complete resource ledger and either a residual lower bound or an absorbing construction.
attachments.scale_up_when: Every moved resource has an operational measure and a matched protocol.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A matched proof system pair differing in succinctness but not in certified task.
attachments.source_title: Succinct Proof Does Not Erase Provenance Debt

attachments.avoid: Stopping at analogy or comparing endpoints without operation order.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Identical terminal values with acyclic versus cyclic operation provenance.
attachments.recommended_attack: Map serialization graphs to the frozen reconciliation category and test each direction of the proposed correspondence separately.
attachments.reusable_output: Two directional theorems, exhaustive tiny-history table, and first failed direction.
attachments.scale_up_when: The mapping predicts a held-out history without changing transaction semantics.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest transaction histories containing one serialization cycle and matched acyclic controls.

attachments.avoid: Confounding informational topology with ordinary congestion.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: The same saved schedules before and after one added gossip path.
attachments.recommended_attack: Run a controlled edge-addition experiment while holding load, routing budget, failures, data semantics, and safe action fixed.
attachments.reusable_output: Causal effect estimate, complete logs, and replay bundle.
attachments.scale_up_when: The effect replicates across new saved schedules and has a mechanism-specific mediator.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: One replayable network schedule in which exactly one gossip path can be added.

attachments.avoid: Declaring new curvature after omitting an ordinary control port, memory, or phase.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: The focal routed process versus complete coherent, dephased, and route-erased nulls.
attachments.recommended_attack: Reconstruct an implementation-complete process tensor including routes, controls, memories, and readout, then fit the strongest standard-quantum absorber.
attachments.reusable_output: Process reconstruction, uncertainty-aware null residual, and omitted-port audit.
attachments.scale_up_when: A residual remains after held-out controls under the frozen complete implementation.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A routed coherent process with identical reduced endpoints and explicit route-erased and dephased controls.

attachments.avoid: Studying state convergence while leaving access and public actions undefined.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Exact fixed algebra versus the approximate action algebra at finite noise and time.
attachments.recommended_attack: Compute the fixed algebra and spectral contraction exactly, then derive perturbation or diamond-norm bounds for approximate convergence.
attachments.reusable_output: Convergence theorem, rate/error bound, and tight channel examples.
attachments.scale_up_when: The small exact result extends under a stated perturbation class.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest noncommuting noisy channel semigroup with a nontrivial invariant action algebra.

attachments.avoid: Equating redundancy, fidelity, or one chosen decoder with public facthood.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Crossing one access or erasure threshold while the logical fact and task stay fixed.
attachments.recommended_attack: Use operator-algebra quantum error correction with frozen access, adversary, decoder family, and safe actions.
attachments.reusable_output: Algebraic correspondence, decoder-independent portion, and boundary counterexample.
attachments.scale_up_when: The same action semantics works in a second code family or the distributed twin.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The first stabilizer or subsystem code with a nontrivial correctable logical algebra under varying access.
attachments.source_title: Public Fact as Correctable Logical Algebra

attachments.avoid: Renaming provenance labels as syndromes and calling that a duality.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Distinct unsafe provenance loops sharing one syndrome or one provenance distinction requiring none.
attachments.recommended_attack: Construct the map between provenance sectors and error cosets, then test faithfulness, fullness, and dimension bounds.
attachments.reusable_output: Explicit map, tight dimension bound, and first obstruction.
attachments.scale_up_when: The map predicts a new code or network instance without relabeling.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A small code with multiple provenance sectors and a nontrivial syndrome space.

attachments.avoid: Substituting raw mutual information for action-relative reconciliation.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Equal raw channel statistics but different action-confusability structure.
attachments.recommended_attack: Seek a graph-entropy, rate-distortion, or zero-error coding theorem with matching achievability and converse.
attachments.reusable_output: Operational rate, optimal code, converse certificate, and task-sensitivity analysis.
attachments.scale_up_when: The exact small solution yields a constructive code for a larger frozen class.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest nontrivial action-confusability graph with two tasks on one raw channel.

attachments.avoid: Testing named distance formulas one at a time or refitting the task.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: One frozen scalar metric class versus an operational ordering reversal.
attachments.recommended_attack: State axioms for a scalar metric class and synthesize two tasks or channels with equal scalar value but opposite capability order.
attachments.reusable_output: A minimal counterexample that excludes the whole declared metric class.
attachments.scale_up_when: The counterexample is invariant to allowed reparameterizations and task labels.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest alphabets and intervention sets supporting an ordering reversal.

attachments.avoid: Treating observability as capability while ignoring controllability, risk, and cost.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Joint-observability rank versus safe-action equivalence with control and cost explicit.
attachments.recommended_attack: Quotient histories by action response and compare that quotient with observability rank or the Gramian under a frozen control set.
attachments.reusable_output: Each implication, rank test, and counterexamples for missing control assumptions.
attachments.scale_up_when: The correspondence predicts a held-out control intervention.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A finite system where individual observability fails and joint observability succeeds.

attachments.avoid: Enumerating all interventions or silently granting unphysical testers.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Minimal extracted basis versus exhaustive interventions on the same tiny class.
attachments.recommended_attack: Use span, convex separation, and basis extraction to replace universal intervention enumeration with a finite witness basis.
attachments.reusable_output: Compactness theorem, basis algorithm, and counterexample under restricted testers.
attachments.scale_up_when: The basis generalizes under a stated dimension or convexity bound.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A finite-dimensional tester space with a small process class and an exhaustible intervention set.

attachments.avoid: Large parameter grids or mistaking slow relaxation for hysteresis.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Connectivity and hardening changes with evidence accuracy and load held fixed.
attachments.recommended_attack: Analyze fixed points and bifurcations first, then use targeted numerical continuation and matched upward/downward sweeps.
attachments.reusable_output: Bifurcation diagram, finite-size behavior, saved trajectories, and rival fit.
attachments.scale_up_when: The reduced mechanism predicts the operating region for larger systems.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A reduced stochastic model with separately controlled access, conflict propagation, and safe action.

attachments.avoid: Exponent fishing, visual collapse alone, or inferring universality from one architecture.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Out-of-sample size predictions rather than in-sample visual collapse.
attachments.recommended_attack: Preregister rival scaling forms, reserve held-out sizes, and allocate new sizes at maximum predictive disagreement.
attachments.reusable_output: Predictive comparison, collapse uncertainty, and next-size acquisition rule.
attachments.scale_up_when: A rival is separated on held-out sizes with finite-size corrections explicit.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest family of system sizes at which smooth, critical, crossover, and first-order rivals diverge.

attachments.avoid: Building a monolithic general prover before the three return contracts work end to end.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Exhaustive tiny-instance truth versus compiler output and independent certificate verification.
attachments.recommended_attack: Reduce factorization, sufficient refinement, and class-relative remainder to exact equivalence or reachability games and emit a certificate in every branch.
attachments.reusable_output: Composable compiler core, canonical cache, three proof-object types, and regression corpus.
attachments.scale_up_when: The complete vertical slice is correct before language or state-space expansion.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A tiny complete input language with at least one example in every return branch.

attachments.avoid: Treating compiler success, test coverage, or a serialized trace as ontological proof.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: A valid certificate versus mutations that omit one assumption or inference.
attachments.recommended_attack: Define a conclusion-sensitive proof grammar and build a small independent verifier separated from the search implementation.
attachments.reusable_output: Verifier, certificate grammar, mutation tests, and conclusion-grade receipt.
attachments.scale_up_when: Every inference and assumption has a rejection control.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: One valid and several minimally corrupted certificates for every compiler conclusion type.

attachments.avoid: Looking for a frequency shift or dephasing that a classical mixture can reproduce.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Coherent history recombination versus the strongest classical random-history channel with identical average shift.
attachments.recommended_attack: Calculate the coherent prediction and full classical channel set, optimize the separating control, and build the calibration budget around the predicted margin.
attachments.reusable_output: Assay passport, convex-null distance, error budget, sample rule, and full outcome record.
attachments.scale_up_when: The simulated separation exceeds systematic and model-completion uncertainty under held-out calibration.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest coherent proper-time process with a classical-history convex hull and a recombination observable.

attachments.avoid: Changing the decoder, observer boundary, or provenance definition at each setting.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: One added provenance distinction at fixed conventional channel resources.
attachments.recommended_attack: Sweep provenance capacity while holding noise, decoder, energy, access, and task fixed; estimate the threshold before translating to a clock.
attachments.reusable_output: Operational provenance measure, response surface, threshold uncertainty, and platform error requirement.
attachments.scale_up_when: The twin predicts a robust effect large enough for a frozen clock assay.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A routed quantum twin with one authenticated provenance distinction and matched ordinary channel capacity.

attachments.avoid: Comparing unmatched capabilities or omitting memory, coherence, trust, and support.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Equal task performance under a complete resource ledger with versus without the focal finality structure.
attachments.recommended_attack: Define action optionality and resource monotones, derive a convex or information-theoretic lower bound, and seek an achieving construction.
attachments.reusable_output: Lower and upper bounds, achieving specimen, complete ledger, and remaining gap.
attachments.scale_up_when: The operational measure and ledger transfer unchanged across a second fixture.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A matched protocol pair with identical action task but different finality or optionality.

attachments.avoid: Defining the residual to be zero or weakening the comparison protocol.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Focal protocol versus a fully resource-matched ordinary implementation.
attachments.recommended_attack: Construct the strongest reversible or ordinary-accounting implementation and explicitly absorb every apparent actualization cost into known resources.
attachments.reusable_output: Residual upper bound and the protocol that attains it.
attachments.scale_up_when: Every ledger term is operationally matched and the residual is calibration-limited.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The same matched protocols and complete ledger used by TR-A.

attachments.avoid: Defining equivalence using every possible experiment and then claiming sufficiency.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: The frozen quotient prediction versus one controlled expansion of admissible actions.
attachments.recommended_attack: Construct the behavioral quotient under declared interventions, prove composition and refinement properties, and reserve a held-out intervention.
attachments.reusable_output: Quotient object, functoriality conditions, held-out result, and exact refinement semantics.
attachments.scale_up_when: The quotient composes across two agents or process stages without semantic refit.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: Two histories merged by one finite action set and split by one controlled action-set expansion.

attachments.avoid: Turning finite underdetermination into universal anti-realism.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Identical finite evidence and actions versus divergent ontological interpretation.
attachments.recommended_attack: Construct the explicit operational translation and prove the equivalence while stating the additional intervention that would separate the models if available.
attachments.reusable_output: Scoped underdetermination theorem, model pair, translation, and ontology-license grammar.
attachments.scale_up_when: The equivalence is exact on the declared surface and its scope is machine-readable.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: Two ontologically different models exactly equivalent on one frozen finite evidence surface.

attachments.avoid: Importing dimension, metric, manifold, or causal geometry through the input record.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Reconstruction-fit observables versus geometric observables reserved as held-out predictions.
attachments.recommended_attack: Generate countermodels first, then add locality, dimension, scale, and regularity assumptions one at a time until uniqueness up to declared gauge is earned.
attachments.reusable_output: Minimal assumption set, reconstruction algorithm, gauge class, and irreducible countermodel.
attachments.scale_up_when: A held-out geometric prediction succeeds without changing the record definition.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest pair of nonisomorphic candidate geometries sharing the same certified meta-records.

attachments.avoid: Calling every route-dependent phase curvature or fitting a continuum story per cover.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Known curved, flat, and topology-only specimens under the same route and control implementation.
attachments.recommended_attack: Define a discrete connection and gauge-invariant loop observable, subtract complete ordinary phases, and test naturality under controlled refinement.
attachments.reusable_output: Refinement law, invariance audit, collision table, and continuum candidate map.
attachments.scale_up_when: The observable converges consistently across independent covers and survives the implementation-complete null.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: A synthetic discrete complex with known curvature plus flat topologically nontrivial controls.

attachments.avoid: Using static or unauthenticated channel capacity as reality bandwidth.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Static connectivity versus time-respecting authenticated capacity for one action commodity.
attachments.recommended_attack: Build a time-expanded authenticated flow graph and seek matching max-flow/min-cut converse and achievability under the frozen adversary.
attachments.reusable_output: Cut certificate, achieving code or protocol, and adversarial trace.
attachments.scale_up_when: The theorem predicts a larger replayable network without changing authentication semantics.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: The smallest temporal network for which static and time-respecting authenticated cuts differ.

attachments.avoid: Post hoc regression on convenient graph summaries or allowing topology to change the task.
attachments.first_decisive_contrast: Held-out edge additions or removals with all non-topological fields frozen.
attachments.recommended_attack: Use factorial topology changes while separately holding access, provenance, noise, and resources fixed; fit a preregistered sparse causal response.
attachments.reusable_output: Causal topology contributions, interaction terms, predictions, and failed invariance cases.
attachments.scale_up_when: The same decomposition predicts held-out interventions on both twins.
attachments.smallest_informative_object: One common task instantiated on matched distributed and routed-quantum twins with controlled edge interventions.
